sloka: गन्धर्वाः किंनरा सिद्धा नागा विद्याधराः तथा ।रमन्ते सहिताः तत्र नारीभिः भास्वर प्रभाः ॥४-४३-४९॥
transliteration: gandharvāḥ kiṁnarā siddhā nāgā vidyādharāḥ tathā ।ramante sahitāḥ tatra nārībhiḥ bhāsvara prabhāḥ ॥4-43-49॥

translations.english: 'The trees of that region deliver beds with colourful spreads. Some trees yield garlands of flowers pleasing to the heart.
